name: AKD PC SETTINGS AIM STUDIO PREMIUM EDITION - v5.4.0 FINAL RELEASE
title: AKD PC SETTINGS & AIM STUDIO v5.4.0 — FINAL ULTRA ZERO-LAG RELEASE
changelog:
=== AKD PC SETTINGS AIM STUDIO PREMIUM EDITION v5.4.0 FINAL ULTRA RELEASE ===
- Independent FPS Manager Hotkeys: Dedicated hotkeys (Cycle Next, Prev Profile, Toggle Boost) completely separated from AKD AIM OPT; rebinding never conflicts or clears the other.
- Pause Hotkeys Toggle: Added live Pause/Resume button in FPS Manager with status chip (ACTIVE / PAUSED) to temporarily suspend multiplier hotkeys during normal PC typing.
- Profile Limit Clamping (999 FPS MAX & 120 FPS MIN): Eliminated circular profile wrapping; pressing Next on 999 MAX clamps and flashes [ ALREADY MAX (999 FPS) ] on the in-game HUD and desktop toast; pressing Prev on 120 MIN clamps with [ ALREADY MIN (120 FPS) ].
- UI/UX Layout Collision Fix: Fixed card overlaps in FPS Manager (eliminated 24px collision between hotkeyCard and clientCard), SubTab 4 (cRamLimit height clamped to 235 before cLockedCard), and SubTab 7 (cRestore height clamped to 172 before cVault).
- Zero-Disappearance Page Scrolling: Fixed Page.RefreshScroll to ignore hidden/inactive subtab panels (!c.Visible), eliminating phantom scroll space and preventing cards from disappearing off-screen.
- Fixed Meter Vanishing & Unhide Freeze: Resolved zombie thread window deadlock in AKD AIM OPT HUD overlay; unhiding via Home key or Reset Position (End) instantly re-anchors without freezing.
- Persistent Mouse Cursor Speed: Preserved user pointer sensitivity across Windows registry and Win32 SPI; mouse cursor speed never automatically resets to 10.
- Next-Gen Stabilizer Drag Curves: Enhanced progressive vertical drag curves with 3.5%-35% micro-tremor deadzone jitter damping for crisp Free Fire drag headshots.
- FPS Manager Target Memory & Emulator Auto-Scan: Automatically scans PC for BlueStacks 5 and MSI App Player; displays real-time badges (Installed [✓/✗] and FPS Meter Active [✓/✗]), remembers chosen target profile in registry across launches, and auto-selects MSI if BlueStacks is absent.
- Unified v5.4 Release: Synchronized standalone ZIP, setup installer, signed binaries, and cloud update payloads.
